verdict.rationale: telli's built-in AI assistant Charlie is documented as able to "analyze your calls", and the platform tracks success rate and call outcome fields. However, nothing shows the AI automatically reviewing every call, scoring quality, or flagging failures; call analysis and feedback submission read as user-driven. Missing for 10: automatic per-call AI quality scoring, automated failure flagging, automated resolution analysis, detailed docs on how Charlie's call analysis works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
